backbone._model_id_note: AS2M-supervised-finetuned, matching the BEATs checkpoint the mid teacher used (BEATs_iter3_plus_AS2M_finetuned_on_AS2M_cpt2). ta012/SSLAM_pretrain (self-supervised only) gave a clean-noise teacher of 0.6576 on 2026-09-28 vs BEATs 0.7799 and stopped at the gate; the 0.502 AudioSet mAP that motivated SSLAM is the finetuned model's number.
backbone._norm_divisor_note: Verified 2026-09-28 by zero-shot AudioSet-head accuracy on 720 clean high-band noise clips: divisor 2.0 -> 0.7292, 1.0 -> 0.6333; padding to 1024 frames hurts (0.7069 / 0.5292).
backbone._pooling_note: cls_fcnorm = fc_norm(CLS), the finetuned checkpoint's own classification path. head_init audioset = start the 36-way head from its AudioSet rows (LP-FT, Kumar et al. ICLR 2022). With mean_patches + random head the clean-noise teacher reached 0.6912, below the 0.7292 this head gets zero-shot.

teacher._lr_note: Teacher sweep 2026-09-28 (val acc, 15-20 dB clean noise, AudioSet-warm head): head-only 0.7273, blocks6 enc1e-5 0.7292, blocks6 enc3e-6 0.7380. head_lr is the finetune head lr: at 1e-3 it knocked the warm-started head off in epoch 1.

loss._note: crd_level 'patch' aligns every patch token against the teacher's; 'pooled' reproduces the BEATs project's single-vector CRD. patch is the reason for switching backbones - see VERSIONS.md. Weights r/a/b come from the CRD reference repo (-r 1 -a 1 -b 0.8); do not invent replacements.

gates._teacher_gate_note: Gate = baseline_band_accuracy + 0.10 = 0.6315. The mid project's absolute 0.75 floor sat above a 0.67 mixture baseline; carried to this band (baseline 0.53) it stopped a clean-noise teacher of 0.738, which is 0.21 above the baseline - twice the mid project's teacher headroom (0.78 - 0.67 = 0.11). Flagged as uncalibrated for SSLAM/high from the first commit; recalibrated after the teacher sweep of 2026-09-28.
gates._baseline_band_note: Published BEATs-Mixture, Result.xlsx 'Theo tung SNR': (0.5769@15dB + 0.4861@20dB)/2 and (0.5757+0.4830)/2, equal support (1080 each). This is the gate; it is NOT the same run as BEATs_Experts/checkpoint/test_metrics_36.json (that checkpoint's own 15/20 numbers are 0.6102/0.5315 - a different training run, no per-clip predictions, cannot enter a paired test).

published_baseline.name: BEATs-Mixture (Result.xlsx)
published_baseline._note: Copied from Result.xlsx, sheet 'Theo tung SNR', rows BEATs-Mixture / final. Only accuracy and F1 exist there, and no per-clip predictions, so it cannot enter the McNemar comparison.

evaluation._note: Validation (checkpoint selection) and test use only the 15-20 dB rows. Training still uses all six SNR levels - more data, FiLM tells the model where it is.
